HesabatyManifestDoc.title: HesabatyManifestDoc
HesabatyManifestDoc.description: Company manifest document storing metadata, shard counts, and lightweight non-sharded database core payload

companyCode.description: Company tenant code such as COMP-102

companyName.description: Display name of the company or establishment

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of the last sync mutation

updatedBy.description: Name of the operator who saved the change

updatedRole.description: Role of the operator who saved the change

deviceId.description: Originating browser or device instance ID

actionDesc.description: Short summary of the last recorded accounting action

sharded.description: True when heavy collections are sharded into chunked shard documents

shardPrefix.description: Prefix used for shard document IDs

shardCounts.description: Count of shard pages per collection

hasSeparateLogo.description: True when company logo is stored in a dedicated asset document

data.description: Serialized core AccountingDB JSON string excluding sharded arrays and separate logo

HesabatyShardDoc.title: HesabatyShardDoc
HesabatyShardDoc.description: Chunked collection shard document supporting 10M+ records within 1 MiB document limits

count.description: Number of records inside this shard

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of the shard write

itemsJson.description: Serialized JSON array slice for this shard page

logo.description: Base64 or data URL of company logo

HesabatyDirectoryDoc.description: Directory registry mapping company codes to company metadata

/hesabaty_app_data/{docId}.description: Isolated tenant manifests, sharded collection pages, separated logos, and company directory registry

/test/{docId}.description: Startup Firestore server connectivity verification path
